subject: Class of 2024 Commencement
overview: Medford High School and Medford Vocational Technical High School held their 2024 commencement exercises, featuring addresses from student leaders, faculty, and city officials followed by the presentation of diplomas.

items.title: Welcome and Opening Remarks
items.summary: Principal Marta Cabral welcomed guests, led ceremonial recognitions, and congratulated the graduating seniors on their growth and resilience.

items.title: Vocational Technical High School Address
items.summary: Principal Director Chad Fallon commended the 106 career and technical education graduates for completing over 900 hours of technical instruction.

items.title: Faculty Address
items.summary: Selected faculty speaker Nicholas Kane shared three life lessons with the class, encouraging students to show up, embrace their potential, and treat others with kindness and respect.

items.title: Class President Address
items.summary: Senior Class President Darren Truong reflected on his high school years and urged his peers to actively tackle generational challenges and give back to their community.

items.title: Mayor's Address
items.summary: Mayor Breanna Lungo-Koehn congratulated the graduates on navigating their high school years through the pandemic and urged them to embrace challenges with courage and compassion.

items.title: Superintendent's Address
items.summary: Superintendent Dr. Marice Edouard-Vincent commended the graduates and encouraged them to pursue ambitious dreams while staying rooted in their community values.

items.title: Career and Technical Education Student Address
items.summary: Top-ranked CTE student Matthew Harris discussed combining programming and robotics, encouraging classmates to embrace multidisciplinary intersections in their lives and careers.

items.title: Salutatory Address
items.summary: Salutatorian Eleanor Nkera used the metaphor of particle collisions to describe the high school experience and urged graduates to maintain their connections moving forward.

items.title: Valedictory Address
items.summary: Valedictorian Oprah Nkera spoke about navigating life choices and urged classmates to stay committed to integrity, compassion, and positive social impact.

items.title: Presentation of Diplomas
items.summary: Faculty advisors read the roll of graduates as diplomas were awarded to seniors from Medford High School and Medford Vocational Technical High School.

items.title: Conferral of Diplomas and Closing
items.summary: Principal Marta Cabral directed the graduates to turn their tassels and officially declared them alumni of Medford High School.
